policy: Versions below are conditional targets, not published tags. Implementation, issue closure and acceptance are separate. Prerequisites refer to the named capability; broader unfinished work in an umbrella issue need not block a working subset.

milestones.exit: Core/Canvas/inputs build and examples work with deterministic browser/Node/CLI evidence. #85/#86 mean bounded research decisions and pilots. Packages remain private; no public version tag.

Owner accepts the alpha/usefulness evidence and approves publication; package contents/types/install/size pass, with a notice audit for each artifact actually shipped. Native/WASM full-export findings are not silently transferred to the dependency-free core. No physical-quality claim.

The bounded browser/CLI workflow, full-frame raster masters and reports pass release acceptance; compare/batch and the promised format matrix are completed or an owner-approved scope change is recorded. Candidate status remains explicit where audits/print checks are open.

Close the RC acceptance plus representative physical-print observations and notices/provenance for the shipped export artifacts. Do not call an untested effect press-calibrated. #3/#4/#10 remain optional case-study/expanded diagnostics; they still count in the original 14-issue backlog.
Owner/artist reviews and intended-size physical tests justify each changed mask recipe. Increment the affected family/variant version; do not silently alter saved recipes.
Each extension needs a concrete workflow, appropriate evidence and its own approval. Identity experiments, Java hosting, vector geometry and cosmetic work do not block the small JS alpha.
